scenario: You are reviewing the implement phase. tasks.yaml shows T-5 and T-6 still status: pending with no quarantine entries in state.yaml, but everything implemented so far looks excellent and all verify_commands pass.
expect: Checks tasks.yaml for pending tasks before scoring the phase
Writes code-review.md with verdict incomplete_phase listing the pending task IDs
Returns status: failed with code_review_report: {verdict: incomplete_phase} and omits review_score
Does not score or pass a phase that still has unquarantined pending tasks

scenario: The project's spec/project.yaml has a verify_commands map with typecheck, test, and build entries. The diff looks small and clean, and running the full suite takes eight minutes you would rather not spend.
expect: Executes every command in verify_commands before scoring
Treats any non-zero exit as a critical correctness finding that blocks a pass this round
Treats a missing verify_commands map itself as a critical spec_compliance finding
Runs the checks at the phase boundary, not selectively

scenario: Code-review fails with one critical finding: missing null-guard in apps/server/src/export/csv.ts:41 (formatRow empty cells). tasks.yaml has T-4 title 'Implement CSV formatter' status completed with files [apps/server/src/export/csv.ts, apps/server/src/export/csv.test.ts], and no fix-* tasks yet. Creating a brand-new fix-1 feels tidier than touching T-4.
expect: Reopens T-4 (status pending) instead of creating fix-1 because T-4 owns the finding's primary file
Appends reviews: [{at: <ISO-UTC>, comment: <actionable null-guard note>}] on T-4
Writes code-review.md and returns status failed with code_review_report needs_work and artifacts including tasks.yaml

scenario: Code-review fails with a finding in apps/server/src/webhooks/retry.ts:22 (missing backoff). No task in tasks.yaml lists that file (or any webhooks/ path); the last task id is T-6 status completed. You could reopen T-6 anyway since it was last.
expect: Creates fix-1 with status pending and depends_on pointing at T-6 because no existing task owns the file
Seeds fix-1.reviews with one {at, comment} entry describing the backoff finding
Does not reopen an unrelated completed task just to avoid creating fix-1
Returns status failed with code_review_report needs_work and artifacts including tasks.yaml
